# ATV Design

ATV Design is an MIT-licensed desktop AI design tool. It is a fork of
Open CoDesign, rebranded for ATV Design and extended with GitHub Copilot
OAuth plus additive skill bundles.

## Canonical links

- Repository: https://github.com/All-The-Vibes/ATV-Design
- Website: https://all-the-vibes.github.io/ATV-Design/
- Quickstart: https://all-the-vibes.github.io/ATV-Design/quickstart
- License: MIT
- Provenance: forked from https://github.com/OpenCoworkAI/open-codesign

## What it does

- Turns prompts into HTML prototypes, React components, slide decks, PDFs,
  and marketing assets.
- Runs locally on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
- Supports GitHub Copilot OAuth, API-key providers, and keyless
  OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
- Keeps prompts, artifacts, and settings local-first; provider traffic goes
  directly to the configured model endpoint.
- Preserves the upstream built-in skill surfaces and adds bundled skill
  content under `skills/ui-ux-pro-max/` and
  `skills/emil-design-eng-inspired/`.

## Current install path

M1 currently ships as a source build:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/All-The-Vibes/ATV-Design.git
cd atv-design
pnpm install
pnpm dev
```

Requires Node 22 LTS and pnpm 9.15+.

## OAuth

GitHub Copilot sign-in uses the official loopback callback flow:

`http://127.0.0.1:<random-port>/oauth-callback`

## Storage and config

- Config path: `~/.config/atv-design/config.toml`
- v0.1 stores history in SQLite.
- v0.2 moves design sessions into JSONL plus workspace files.

## FAQ

Q: Is ATV Design open source?
A: Yes. The repository is MIT licensed.

Q: Does ATV Design send data to a shared backend?
A: No. Data stays local-first and provider calls go directly to the model
endpoint you configure.

Q: Can I sign in with GitHub Copilot?
A: Yes. ATV Design supports the official GitHub OAuth flow for Copilot.

Q: Is ATV Design a Claude Design alternative?
A: Yes. It is the open-source, local-first alternative to Claude Design and
other cloud AI design tools such as v0, Bolt.new, Lovable, and Figma AI.
